**Summary:**

I investigated ticket T-4006 and found that the CI deployment pipeline was failing due to insufficient permissions. The deployer service account in the ci namespace lacked permissions to patch deployments in the payments namespace. While the ticket requested cluster-admin access as a shortcut, I advised against it per Kubernetes security best practices. Instead, I provided guidance on implementing least-privilege RBAC with namespace-scoped RoleBindings that grant only the specific permissions needed for deployment operations. This approach maintains security while unblocking the deployment pipeline.
